quarterly_data.quarter: NVIDIA press release: NVIDIA Launches Space Computing, Rocketing AI Into Orbit (03-16-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: NVIDIA release (GTC): NVIDIA Space-1 Vera Rubin Module is the latest part of NVIDIA's accelerated platform for space - compared with the H100 GPU, the Rubin GPU on the module delivers up to 25x more AI compute for space-based inferencing, for orbital data centers, geospatial intelligence and autonomous space operations; IGX Thor and Jetson Orin bring edge AI inference to orbit in a compact module. Availability: IGX Thor, Jetson Orin and the RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell Server Edition GPU are available today; the Space-1 Vera Rubin Module will be available at a later date.
